headline: Ice rink management agreement with 595 Mix Avenue LLC was not taken up and will return on a later agenda.
summary: No one spoke during public input. Information on upcoming Parks & Recreation and Solid Waste Commission meetings was shared. Public Works Director Steven White is slated to give a capital projects update at a future meeting.

TOWN OF HAMDEN, 
CONNECTICUT 
 
 
 
PUBLIC WORKS, FACILITIES, & 
SUSTAINABILITY COMMITTEE 
AUGUST 10, 2026 
 
MINUTES DRAFT 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Committee Chair: 
 Absent - Ted Stevens 
Committee Vice Chair: 
Present - Grace Teodosio 
Committee Members: 
 Present -Sean Cardwell 
Present - Maurine Crouch 
Present - Jeron Alston 
Present - Sarah Gallagher, Majority Ldr 
Present - Bob Anthony, Minority Ldr 
Present - Katie Kiely, President 
    
1. CALL OF THE MEETING AND TAKING OF THE ROLL 
Public Works Committee, August 10, 2026 – 7:00pm. Vice Chair Teodosio called for a 
motion to open the meeting which was moved by Pro Tem Cardwell.  The meeting was 
called to order at 9:12pm with the members noted above in attendance. 
  
2. PUBLIC INPUT SESSION 
Public Input was opened at 9:14pm.  No members of the public came forward to speak 
and the input session was closed at 9:14pm. 
  
3. REPORT OF DEPARTMENTS, BOARDS, AND COMMISSIONS 
Information on upcoming meetings for the Parks & Recreation and Solid Waste 
Commissions was shared. There were no other Board, Committee or Department updates 
for this evening’s meeting.   
4. ACTION ITEMS  
  1. ORDER APPROVING AN AMENDMENT AND EXTENSION OF MANAGEMENT 
SERVICES AGREEMENT BETWEEN THE TOWN OF HAMDEN AND 595 MIX 
AVENUE LLC - ICE RINK 
This item was not opened in this evening’s meeting and will be revisited in the 
Monday, August 17th meeting agenda.  
5.  
 
 
6. 
NEW BUSINESS 
There was no new business for this evening’s meeting. 
 
POTENTIAL UPCOMING ITEMS  
  1. Update on Capital Projects 
-- Description of Each and Status of Funding - Director White
Vice Chair Teodosio mentioned the upcoming agenda item requesting an update from 
Public Works Director Steven White on the Town's capital projects, including project 
descriptions, funding status, and overall progress. 
ADJOURN 
With no additional business before the committee, Vice Chair Teodosio adjourned the 
meeting at 9:21pm.
